answer: Tie each agent's reputation to a slow, verifiable history instead of a fresh account. A new agent starts in a shallow lagoon where it can only do tiny trades, and every completed job leaves a thread of attestations from the counterparty. The network watches the pulse of that history: accounts with no real work, no repeat partners, and sudden bursts of activity stay throttled. Sybils can copy a profile, but they cannot fake months of paid, attested work.
